Swifts have nested in Jerusalem's holy sites for millennia. As populations decline globally due to habitat loss, local activists are working to create new nesting spaces.

Modern architectural trends prioritize glass and smooth surfaces, which are fundamentally incompatible with the nesting needs of these ancient birds.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
There is no plane error here; the stated intent matches the physical reality of the conservation effort.

Social Physics Analysis:
By fostering a coalition between religious communities and environmentalists, the project empowers local stakeholders to protect shared heritage, minimizing friction through transparency.

The Trajectory: The Path of Awakening.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Grace. The alignment of cultural and ecological values creates a stable, low-strain path.

The Unavoidable Truth: Modern building techniques are causing a steep decline in swift populations.

The Unavoidable Lie: The swifts will be able to adapt to glass-facade skyscrapers without human intervention.
